items.text: Hey everyone

notes.title: A big new update is coming to Aggelos 2, and you can try it out right now! 🎉

items.text: Patch 1214 is now available through the Public Beta branch, bringing huge additions, improvements, and fixes to the game.

With this update, you can try out Easy Mode, zoom in on the map, place up to 50 map beacons, get additional progression guidance from the Seer, track your rank-related progress, and skip the intro and cutscenes.
And that's just the beginning! Patch 1214 includes a number of additional fixes and improvements across the game, making this one of our biggest updates yet.
Check out the full patch notes below for everything included in the Public Beta.
An Easy Mode option has been added when starting a new game.
The map can now be zoomed in to help with legibility.
The Seer now indicates the next area of interest within the map for progression.
The Seer now provides more story information.
Map beacon limit has been increased to 50.
Cutscenes and Intro can now be skipped.
Continue is highlighted by default within the Main Menu to prevent accidental overwrites of existing saves by clicking New Game instead.
The game now saves at the end, so that the final status can be maintained if the player returns to the save. Maintaining 100% map.
The game now displays a rank and tracker for all rank related items at the end of the Good or Bad ending.
The player can no longer get stuck transitioning to the main menu after defeating Badu during Bad Ending.
The game now includes an icon which displays collectibles on the map when the frame has been discovered.
There is no longer a graphical artefact if the player quits to the Main Menu during speed boost.
The Alchemist can now be interacted with when Divine Tears are present in Hard Mode.
The Skull Boss no longer remains present after being defeated if the battle time is extended.
Grappling hook colliders have been fixed.

notes.title: How to Access the Public Beta

items.text: Open Steam and find Aggelos 2 in your library.
Right-click the game and select Properties.
Go to the ‘Game versions & betas’ tab.
Select the Public Beta branch from the dropdown.
Let Steam update the game, and you're ready to play!
You should now be running Version 1214!
If you encounter any issues while playing this version, please let us know in the comments below or in the Feedback & Bug Discussion thread.
Hi everyone,
Your feedback and support have been incredibly helpful, and we’re happy to say that Patch #1174 is now officially live for everyone on the main branch!
This update brings balancing adjustments, along with a range of bug fixes and gameplay improvements!
Check out the full changelog below to see everything included in this update:
Difficulty balancing adjusted to reduce the mid-game curve.
Added 'Continue' button within the Main Menu if save data exists.
Fixed collider at the bottom wall at "A" Area of Dark World.
Fixed collider within "A" Area which caused the character to levitate.
Fixed colliders in Dark World A.
Fixed SFX after defeating enemies in Semi Castle.
Fixed spacing between question and options in NPC dialogue at mountain area.
Fixed some enemies which caused replicating SFX when changing form.
Fixed the UI highlight selection getting stuck over the Grappling Hook within the Inventory.
Fixed repeating enemy absorption SFX.
Fixed climbing and Jumping SFX issues.
Fixed jumping underwater glitch.
The player can now hold movement direction between frames to keep going left.
Reduced spikes in G area damage.
Enemies no longer incorrectly move into an inaccessible room when the player stands nearby in level 2.
Underwater effect no longer carries over to a new game after running an existing save.
White block switch no longer disappears during the late game puzzle (Top-right corner).
Korean text no longer overlaps with the dialogue UI box during bat beast monster cutscene.
Japanese text no longer spills out of the UI box during Badu sorcerer's conversation.
Windowed mode added via Screen Mode options.
Submenu transitional load times resolved when using external controllers.
This patch is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with Nintendo Switch coming soon!
We’ve also created a new community feedback thread for this patch, where you can share your thoughts and report any issues you encounter. We’ll be keeping a close eye on the thread and your feedback.
Hi everyone!
We're opening up a Public Beta branch for Aggelos 2!
This beta is a chance for you to try out some upcoming fixes before they go live on the main branch and help us make sure everything is working correctly.

IMPORTANT
Please post any bug reports either in the comments section of this post or in the new BETA Bug Report thread on the Steam forum!
Please do not report a main-branch bug in the beta thread, or report a beta bug as if it were a main-branch bug. This will make it much harder for us to investigate and track down issues.
